integrity: Finite capped-state proof and exact generating-function identities supplied, plus independent vertex-by-vertex finite cross-checks. No independent assessment or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Three-state threshold-one synchronous excitation on two complete graphs joined by one edge, orders a,b>=2. General previously published cycle-irrotationality criterion already implies the qualitative extinction test and aggregate extinction probability. The assessed contribution is the full first-entry layer formulas, orbit census, sharp transient bound, and mirror symmetry; source searches do not establish global priority.
title: Exact first-entry layer laws for Greenberg–Hastings excitation on bridged cliques
